comments.content: `channel='chrome'` is now passed unconditionally, including when `browser_class` is `firefox` or `webkit`; those launch paths cannot use the Chrome channel. It also makes the default Chromium path require a separately installed branded Chrome instead of the browser installed by `playwright`/`patchright install`. Make the channel conditional/configurable, or remove the unsupported browser choices and update installation accordingly.

In headed mode `kwargs` contains neither `viewport` nor `no_viewport`, so Patchright uses its default emulated 1280x720 viewport. Previously `no_viewport=True` made the page use the actual browser window, including fullscreen/custom window sizes. Preserve that behavior with an `else` setting `no_viewport=True` (or explicitly configure the intended headed viewport).

This rewrite also removes the `Element.prototype.attachShadow` wrapper that forced closed shadow roots open. Patchright's anti-detection patches do not replace that browser-use functionality, so DOM extraction can no longer inspect elements created inside closed shadow roots. Keep the attachShadow wrapper separately while removing the navigator stealth shims.
